description: This file provides conversion utilities for serializing and deserializing domain models (Project, Tag, TaskItem) to and from Firestore-compatible maps. It includes specific converters for each domain entity and a base abstract Converter class.

classes.name: FirestoreConverters
classes.description: Provides static instances of domain-specific converters for Firestore serialization.

classes.name: FirestoreProjectConverter
classes.description: Converts Project objects to and from JSON Maps compatible with Firestore.

classes.name: FirestoreTagConverter
classes.description: Converts Tag objects to and from JSON Maps compatible with Firestore.

classes.name: FirestoreTaskConverter
classes.description: Converts TaskItem objects to and from JSON Maps compatible with Firestore.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for converting domain models to/from JSON maps.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes a domain object to a Map<String, Object?> suitable for Firestore.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Map<String, Object?> into a domain object, requiring an id parameter.
